notes.title: Skycadia version 2.0 update!
notes.content:
The Skycadia version 2.0 update is here! Everything from the open beta is now live -- check it out and let us know what you think! Please join the Studio Nisse Discord to give feedback and stay up-to-date on what we're working on!
STUDIO NISSE DISCORD

notes.title: Skycadia Version 2.0 OPEN BETA
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38359049/489cc9fcd78c9591ad731816de6e803a9f53c505.gif

Connect with us on the Studio Nisse Discord

I'd like to invite you all to the Open Beta! Just right-click your Skycadia install in the Steam Library and choose "Properties...", go on the BETAS tab, and choose the Beta branch.

This will switch your install to the Beta branch, and we'll be updating this regularly. Some notes on the Beta:

 We are trying not to break Save States, but it's possible saves will get broken, so play the Beta at your own risk!
 Barrel rolling is now a thing! Double-tap the roll left or roll right button to execute a barrel roll, which deflects enemy bullets back at them and grants brief invulnerability with a cooldown
 Ships, pilots and weapons are functional, but NOT final balancing

Please give us feedback on what you think in the Studio Nisse Discord!

Have fun!! 🛩️

notes.title: Skycadia is coming to Nintendo Switch!!
notes.content:
I'm thrilled to announce that Skycadia is finally coming to the Nintendo Switch!

The eShop page is now live in most territories, so you can Pre-Order or Wishlist it on the eShop Page!

[previewyoutube=2C8bFXspIc8;full][/previewyoutube]

Skycadia will release in all territories on September 8th.

The Switch version of Skycadia has the all-new Story Mode, as well as many other improvements. Please try it on Switch and let me know what you think :)

Skycadia eShop Page: https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/skycadia-switch/

All the best,
Ian

notes.title: Performance Improvements
notes.content:
I've just committed an update that'll noticeably improve Skycadia's performance, especially as you get several minutes into a Bounty Hunt. I'll be doing more performance optimizations soon that should improve framerates overall, but they involve manual updates to art assets, so it'll be a few days before I get that done. Thanks so much for your continued support!

All the best,
Ian @ Studio Nisse

notes.title: Gameplay Balancing Update!!
notes.content:
Rebalancing
Hi everyone! Skycadia's gameplay has been rebalanced to provide a smoother curve of experience -- you should be able to get a bit higher on the leaderboards more easily, but the later game has been rebalanced to be more challenging and to prevent some known "easy" ways to collect bounties. Try it out and let us know what you think in the Skycadia Discussion hub: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1364710/discussions/0/

notes.title: NEW MAPS DECEMBER UPDATE!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=cz2nQVnayWg;full][/previewyoutube]

Explore the world of Skycadia by skimming the frigid waters of the Icy Isles at night, feeling the heat in the Tropic of Gallus, or swooping the trees around the Ornithian Sea! These are the new locales of your most dangerous bounties, or simply enjoy a chill vacation by CRUISIN' through!

NEW FEATURE: When you fly too high, the dizzying heights give you double vision just before your engine stalls -- use this as a warning to drop your altitude before your engines give out!

notes.title: New enemy portraits, bug fixes and quality of life improvements
notes.content:
New Enemy Portraits! You'll see them when you get shot down :D

Bug fixes and QOL improvements:
- Leaderboards now update properly every time you look at them :)
- Colonel achievement should trigger now!
- Fixed a bug with mouse cursor disappearing in the Pause Menu
- Added "Restart" option to Pause Menu
- Dialog bubbles at the beginning of gameplay go away once you've achieved 500 Highest Bounty
- Volume settings now work properly
- End game spawning rates have changed somewhat

Huge thanks to players DGgaralixx and ChunKyPiglets for reporting issues!

Happy hunting!
Ian @ Studio Nisse
